title: Toyota Supplier Early Warning
why: During the 2021 chip shortage Toyota had to cut production, which showed how late warnings hurt even a lean, well-run supply chain. This tool scores every supplier and part each week and flags trouble before lines stop.
problem: A manufacturing company frequently experiences production delays because disruptions in suppliers, inventory and transportation are identified too late. Develop an AI operations system that analyzes supplier, inventory, production and delivery data to identify emerging risks and recommend mitigation actions.
data_note: 30 tier-1 suppliers, 18 parts, 4 assembly lines, 52 weeks of deliveries plus a news feed (sample data).

steps.detail: Deliveries, lead times, defects, inventory, production plan, news
On-time rate, lead-time variability, defect rate
Holt trend model per supplier, 4 weeks ahead
Recent weeks vs the supplier's own baseline (z-score)
Keyword risk scoring of supplier headlines
Trace supplier → part → assembly line, flag single-source parts
Weighted score per supplier and part
Backup supplier, safety stock or expedite, ranked by urgency

questions: Which supplier is most likely to stop a line?
Why is the semiconductor supplier flagged?
Should we raise safety stock or dual-source?
Which assembly line is most exposed?
author: K Mohan Kumar
